limitations: This is a 10000-year dynamical screen, not a Solar-System-age integration.
The inner Solar System is collapsed into one monopole at the initial epoch.
Candidate 9118 elements at the epoch are a declared model assumption, not a JPL state or a new observational fit.
Only candidate 9118 is tested; the result does not cover the wider source-parameter space.
The broad outcome-blind proposal is not an observed TNO prior, posterior population model, or survey selection function.
Perihelion minima and encounters are sampled, not continuously event-located.
The test particles are massless and do not interact with one another.
The convergence checks use the same REBOUND software and are not independent-software replication.
next_required_gate: independent-software replication and an observed-population/selection-function model
nonclaim: This screen cannot detect or exclude Planet X, validate candidate 9118, or convert a simulated source/control difference into observational evidence. Passing means only that the locked model comparison survived its contracted numerical gates.
scientific_scope: Run 100000 matched massless tracers per arm for 10000 years on a DE441-derived real-epoch planetary backbone, comparing candidate-9118 source and no-source populations under a frozen outcome-blind proposal.
